say:1:1621514001:0.text: Give your voice a rest, man. You're making the crops wither.
say:1:1621514001:0.source_cn: 乌鸦兄，不如歇歇嗓子吧？再唱下去，麦田里的稻穗都枯了。

say:2:1621514002:0.source_cn: <hpy>黑眼睛，黑羽毛，黑黑的披风真漂亮~</hpy>

say:3:1621514003:0.text: Ignoring me again? That crow's such a nuisance! Even a rusty bell sounds better than him.
say:3:1621514003:0.source_cn: 又装作没听到吗？这只扰民的鸟，破喉咙比生锈的铃铛还难听。

say:5:1621514004:0.text: Gentlemen, open your eyes to Meowris' schemes! She's about to plunge the Serene Lyceum into chaos!
say:5:1621514004:0.source_cn: 两位，现在不是悠闲的时候，喵丽丝正在策划颠覆莱希拉姆的秩序！

say:9:1621514006:0.text: I'm Woofdale, and I'm putting together a squad to oppose Meowris.
say:9:1621514006:0.source_cn: 我是汪达尔，正在组建一个对抗喵丽丝的小队。

say:11:1621514007:0.text: Cawhaha! Oppose Meowris, the very hope of our future? Don't make me laugh!
say:11:1621514007:0.source_cn: 嘎哈哈！你们怕是对喵丽丝大人有什么误会吧？她可是未来的希望！

say:12:1621514008:0.text: By the way, I've written a song for her. Want to hear me sing it?
say:12:1621514008:0.source_cn: 我还给她写了新歌呢，要不要来段听听？

say:13:1621514009:0.text: Spare me. My ears would bleed if I had to hear you sing again.

say:14:1621514010:0.text: You're just jealous of my voice.

say:19:1621514012:0.text: Maybe... but that's all the more reason for them to fight for the same cause!
say:19:1621514012:0.source_cn: 或许吧……但正因为他们不同，才更该站在一起！
say:19:1621514012:0.male: Maybe... but that's all the more reason for them to fight for the same cause!
say:19:1621514012:0.female: Maybe... but that's all the more reason for them to fight for the same cause!

say:20:1621514015:0.text: Gentlemen, please stop and listen! While the two of you bicker, someone's about to sabotage Serene Lyceum!
say:20:1621514015:0.source_cn: 两位请冷静，现在不是内讧的时候，莱希拉姆已经危在旦夕！...

say:21:1621514016:1.text: Stop? Why don't you do that first? Meowris promises to reshape the world. What about you, doggie?
say:21:1621514016:1.source_cn: 冷静？你才该冷静点吧。喵丽丝会带来新秩序，比你这狗队长...

say:24:1621514018:1.text: Meowris is too brash and showy. I hold no brief for a leader like that.
say:24:1621514018:1.source_cn: 喵丽丝小姐的步调太喧闹，太张扬，的确不符合我理想中的秩序。

say:25:1621514019:1.text: Anyway, I'm not interested in politics. I only seek a reclusive, carefree life in the countryside.
say:25:1621514019:1.source_cn: 不过我一心想归隐田野，随风饮露，与世无争。

say:27:1621514020:1.text: You hardly seemed like a recluse when you snorted at me just now!
say:27:1621514020:1.source_cn: 归隐？你刚才喷我响鼻那叫归隐？别搞笑了！

say:28:1621514021:0.text: I'm so sick of you acting all high and mighty. You're nothing but a country bumpkin!
say:28:1621514021:0.source_cn: 你啊，别把自己说得像个隐居贵族，明明就是个土马！

say:29:1621514022:0.text: What did you say?! Country... bumpkin?!

say:30:1621514023:0.text: I mean, where on earth do you get all that pride from? There's nothing special about your lineage!
say:30:1621514023:0.source_cn: 我说你不过是匹在土堆上跑来跑去的野马，还吹什么血统！太...

say:31:1621514024:1.text: I was born a horse, free to gallop wherever I please! What could be more noble than that!
say:31:1621514024:1.source_cn: 我、我生来自由，风是我披风，大地是我蹄铁！还有什么比这...

say:32:1621514025:1.text: Listen, you wretched crow! Since you're siding with Meowris, I, Alseno, will—
say:32:1621514025:1.source_cn: 听好了！你这死乌鸦！既然你站在喵丽丝那边，那我阿尔塞诺就——

say:35:1621514027:1.text: The argument comes to an abrupt halt...

say:36:1621514028:1.text: The low, authoritative meow sends shivers down everyone's spine.
say:36:1621514028:1.source_cn: 那是一道低沉、悠长、带着某种不容置疑的喵声，如同寒风划...

say:37:1621514029:1.text: All the animals freeze at once, ears pricked and eyes fixed on a silhouette in the forest.
say:37:1621514029:1.source_cn: 片刻后，所有动物都静止不动，耳朵竖起，目光齐刷刷投向林...

say:38:1621514030:1.text: A graceful figure emerges. The crunch of leaves beneath her gentle strides announces <style="stress">her arrival</style>.
say:38:1621514030:1.source_cn: 从林中缓步走出一抹优雅的身影。每一步都踩在落叶最脆弱的...

choice:17:0:1.text: They don't see eye to eye.
choice:17:0:1.male: They don't see eye to eye.
choice:17:0:1.female: They don't see eye to eye.

say:43:1621514013:1.text: Seems like they're going to keep at it for a while…
say:43:1621514013:1.source_cn: 看样子一时半会是停不下来的……
say:43:1621514013:1.male: Seems like they're going to keep at it for a while…
say:43:1621514013:1.female: Seems like they're going to keep at it for a while…

choice:17:1:2.text: Wait for them to calm down.
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 等会他们安静下来再说
choice:17:1:2.male: Wait for them to calm down.
choice:17:1:2.female: Wait for them to calm down.

say:45:1621514014:1.source_cn: ……你不说话，就是默许我继续尝试了。那我去了！
